published_source: Figure 7, panel (b) of the published article (Management Science 71(11), 2025, pp. 9628-9649; papers/mnsc/mnsc.2020.01838.pdf): point estimates are plotted, not printed. authors_code_* = output of Replicate.R line 447 on the shipped data, which the figure plots. Panel labels checked against the article (Nov 2).
replication_status: exact (fixest with event_structure reproduces the authors' Replicate.R event coefficients on the authors' sample; see event_structure.verified)
notes: Kang (2025), 'Price-Fixing Cartels and Firm Innovation', Management Science 71(11). Package: Replicate.R + final cleaned/merged .rds files (real processed data; raw DOJ/VitalLaw, PatentsView and licensed Compustat not shipped). FE: unit + 4-digit-NAICS (patents) or Compustat industry group (R&D) x year (authors: felm(... | assignee_id + paste0(cl, year) | 0 | cl)); here xt_vars = naics4 (= cl) so the time FE is year + year x cl; SE clustered by cl. No controls, no weights. Outcomes are IHS-transformed counts/amounts, precomputed as ihs_* (log(x + sqrt(x^2 + 1)), as in Replicate.R). REVERSE EVENT (cartel breakup), eligible under ruling 5b(b) (own regression, single indicator; all pre-breakup exposed rows are collusion years). Event window -2..+6 around breakup (breakup year absent), reference -1; pre summary = rel -2 only, post summary = rel +1..+6 (event_structure). data_reg_patent_to_others.rds: 16,999 exposed other firms, 26 breakup years; gvar gN = year - TimeToN; binary absorbing regressor (ruling 5b(c)). Nov 2 audit: event_structure records the authors' bins and reference; sample_filter 'pre_sample_adopter == FALSE' removed, pre-sample adopters kept at their true dates (gvar already holds the calendar year; no adoption_var needed). See the log's Nov 2 section.

event_structure.source: Replicate.R line 447: felm(depvar ~ TreatN + TreatN:TimeToN | assignee_id + paste0(cl, year) | 0 | cl) on data_reg_patent_to_others.rds; TimeToN is a factor whose first level is -1, so felm drops TreatN:TimeToN-1 (collinear with the unit FE): reference -1 (article, Figure 7 notes: 'Year -1 is used as the baseline'; year 0 omitted). Treated rows exist only at TimeToN -2, -1, +1..+6 (window trimmed in the shipped file). gvar gN = year - TimeToN (breakup year, constant within firm), so rel = t - g = TimeToN in the annual period index (years 1976-2020 consecutive). 'drop': the shipped file contains treated rows only inside the authors' coded window (the event year itself is omitted), so no ever-treated row falls outside bins and ref (0 rows, checked Nov 2); 'drop' and 'ref' are equivalent here.
event_structure.verified: fixest (es_assign bins; FE assignee_id + cl^year; cluster cl) on the authors' sample (all 482,932 rows of data_reg_patent_to_others.rds) reproduces the 7 coefficients of Replicate.R: max abs diff 2.4e-13 (SE max diff 7.8e-06, felm vs fixest small-sample factor). Pipeline sample equals the authors' (no multi-episode units in this file). No numbers are printed in the article; the figure plots the code output on the shipped data.

pipeline_sample_twfe_source: Nov 2: fixest on the pipeline sample (pre-sample adopters kept at true dates, uid FE + cl^year) with event_structure; post (pre) = equal-weight mean of the post_summary (pre_summary) bins, std = post / population SD of y over all estimation rows.
